steps.name: Reconcile the store
steps.obligation: {item} is discharged or waived, with no more rows claimed back than are proven

report_back.where: the record, state reconcile over the row store
report_back.how: confirm the store status of {item} folds from its verdict rows, not a flipped column
report_back.when: at release, before the close decision

steps.name: Record the human close
steps.obligation: {item} is covered by a recorded human close decision, never auto-advanced

report_back.proof: the decision row that closes the op covering {item}
report_back.where: the record, decision rows for the release op
report_back.how: confirm a human close decision exists and cites {item} among what it releases
report_back.when: at release close, the last gate before the op is done
